verdicts.reason: A reworks the layout for the new shape: confetti and the book sit in a left panel and the card is on the right, so the strong headline stands out and the brand feel survives. Its flaws: the Inkwell & Lantern logo is tiny and jammed into the card's top-left corner, out of line with the right-aligned eyebrow; the card runs to the top and right canvas edges with no margin; and the fine print beside the CTA is nearly body size and competes with the button. B is just the original shrunk and stacked: the confetti is reduced to a thin strip at the top, the book, logo, eyebrow, headline, body, CTA and fine print are crammed into a tight column with almost no gaps, the logo can't be read, and the fine print is tiny.
